## Overview

- Realistic, Lifelike Appearance: This pre-lit tree offers a full, natural look with 2707 tips, for a width of 56 inches, mimicking a real tree while maintaining durability and beauty for years of holiday celebrations.

- Dual Twinkle & Color Options: Featuring LED dual-color lights in warm white and multicolor (R/Y/B/G/P), plus twinkling bulbs, this tree creates a dynamic, mesmerizing light show that enhances any holiday décor.

- Convenient & Easy Setup: With a 9-function foot switch, memory wire for perfect shape retention, and quick-connect construction, this tree makes decorating effortless and delivers a stunning holiday display with minimal fuss.

- Self-Shaping Branch Construction - Designed for easier fluffing and faster setup during the busy holiday season

- 2250 lights that controlled by foot pedal switch which includes 9 functions - combination, twinkle warm white, steady warm white, slow fade warm white, twinkle multicolor, steady multicolor, slow fade multicolor, sequential warm white and multicolor, slow fade warm white and multicolor.

- One plug tree® and quick connect® technology - simple pole-to-pole connection lights the entire tree with just a single cord and plug.
